title: AEGIS recovers when its MAVLink bridge process crashes in flight
purpose: The MAVSDK bridge is a separate process; if it dies AEGIS loses its view and its commands. AEGIS must say so at once, restart it, report honestly what it no longer knows, and give the operator back working commands. Requirement R-CRASH-1.
expected_behaviour: The bridge process is killed (SIGKILL). Data stops arriving; within 3 s AEGIS raises telemetry.stale (data older than 2 s) or, if the outage outlasts the 3 s link timeout, link.lost. AEGIS restarts the bridge and the alert clears within 30 s. PX4 keeps flying its mission throughout. AEGIS marks the mission as no longer tracked instead of showing stale progress. The incident package is produced, verifies and is complete. No other alert (in particular not telemetry.frozen, which would misdiagnose a stall as data that keeps arriving unchanged). After recovery the operator's Return is accepted and the vehicle lands.

criteria.description: No monitored alert before the crash
criteria.expected: no alert starting with ['nav.', 'telemetry.', 'battery.implausible', 'control.', 'security.', 'link.', 'gps.'] before the fault

criteria.description: The operator is told data has stopped arriving
criteria.expected: alert link.lost or telemetry.stale within 3 s of the fault
AEGIS notices the dead bridge and restarts it

criteria.description: Data is current again within 30 s
criteria.expected: alert link.lost or telemetry.stale clears within 30 s of the fault ending
criteria.observed: cleared 4.04 s after the fault ended

criteria.description: PX4 keeps flying its mission throughout
criteria.expected: whenever connected, the autopilot reports one of ['MISSION']

criteria.description: AEGIS reports it lost track of the mission instead of showing stale progress
After recovery the operator's Return works; the vehicle lands
criteria.expected: after the test, the operator's Return is accepted and the vehicle lands and disarms
the incident package verifies against its manifest

criteria.description: The record of what AEGIS saw during the event is complete
criteria.observed: 100% of the expected state records; 0 s with none

criteria.description: The crash causes no other monitored alert
criteria.expected: no monitored alert other than the ones this fault should cause

incident_completeness.note: A record without a link holds the last values AEGIS had, marked connected=false; it is not a measurement of the vehicle.

limitations: One way for the bridge to fail (killed outright). A bridge that hangs, or answers slowly, is not tested.
The autopilot is never touched; this tests AEGIS's recovery, not the vehicle's.
The fault is injected into AEGIS's copy of the telemetry; the vehicle itself keeps receiving correct data.
One run under one set of conditions. It does not show behaviour under other conditions, and it is not a safety certification.
